description: Historical FDA Advisory Committee drug-related vote outcomes. Every record MUST have source-backed provenance (source_url, publication_date, source_doc_type). Records without provenance are rejected by the validator and excluded from empirical scoring.
provenance_policy: No record may power empirical_* basis scoring without a verifiable source_url pointing to an FDA meeting document, Federal Register notice, or published press coverage with an explicit publication_date.

records.indication: Transfusion-dependent anemia in lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (LR-MDS)
records.notes: ODAC voted 12-2 in favor of imetelstat clinical benefit/risk profile. FDA approved Jun 2024. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0000950170-24-031475).

records.indication: Triple-class exposed relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma
records.notes: ODAC voted 8-3 favorable benefit/risk based on KarMMa-3 Phase 3 including OS. sBLA for earlier lines. Verified from 8-K (accession 0001860782-24-000032).

records.committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: CRDAC voted 9-3 benefits outweigh risks for patisiran sNDA for ATTR-CM. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001193125-23-253084).
GeMDAC voted 11-5 that data support efficacy. PDUFA Sep 21, 2024 but FDA issued CRL. Verified from 8-K (accession 0001437749-24-024543).

records.indication: COVID-19 (hospitalized adults at high risk of ARDS)
records.notes: PRDAC voted 8-5 that benefits do NOT outweigh risks for sabizabulin EUA. vote_yes=5 (favorable to drug), vote_no=8 (against). Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001193125-22-297978).

records.committee: Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: EMDAC voted 10-7 benefits outweigh risks for teplizumab to delay clinical T1D. FDA approved Nov 2022 as TZIELD. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001493152-21-013131).

records.committee: Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel of the Medical Devices Advisory Committee
records.notes: Panel voted 8-1 safe, 6-3 effective, 7-2 benefits>risks. Primary question (benefits>risks) recorded. FDA approved May 2024. Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001193125-24-146510).

records.committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
records.indication: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
records.notes: CRDAC voted 8-3 that benefits do NOT outweigh risks. vote_yes=3 (favorable), vote_no=8 (against). Based on GALACTIC-HF Phase 3. Verified from 8-K (accession 0000950170-22-026478).

records.indication: Previously treated NSCLC harboring HER2 exon 20 insertion mutations
records.notes: ODAC voted 9-4 that benefits do NOT outweigh risks. vote_yes=4 (favorable), vote_no=9 (against). Verified from 8-K Exhibit 99.2 (accession 0001193125-22-250274).

records.committee: Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: PCNSDAC voted 4-6 on efficacy question based on CENTAUR Phase 2. FDA later held re-review (Sep 2022, voted 7-2 favor) and approved as Relyvrio. Verified from 8-K (accession 0000950170-22-009674).

records.committee: Cellular, Tissue, and Gene Therapies Advisory Committee
records.indication: Ambulatory patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy with confirmed DMD gene mutation
records.notes: CTGTAC voted 8-6 in support of accelerated approval of SRP-9001. FDA approved Jun 22, 2023 as ELEVIDYS. Verified from Sarepta press release via BusinessWire (permanent URL).

records.committee: Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee
records.indication: Treatment of Alzheimer's disease (traditional approval conversion)
records.notes: PCNSDAC 6-member panel voted unanimously (6-0) that Clarity AD Phase 3 data confirmed clinical benefit of lecanemab. Traditional approval granted Jul 6, 2023. Verified from Biogen investor relations press release.

records.committee: Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee
records.notes: PCNSDAC re-review voted 7-2 that evidence of effectiveness is sufficient to support approval (reversing March 2022 4-6 vote). FDA approved Sep 29, 2022 as Relyvrio. Note: Amylyx voluntarily withdrew Relyvrio in Apr 2024 after Phase 3 PHOENIX failed. Verified from Amylyx investor relations press release.

records.indication: KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC (full approval conversion)
records.notes: ODAC voted 10-2 that PFS per BICR from CodeBreaK 200 confirmatory trial cannot be reliably interpreted. Question: 'Can the primary endpoint, PFS per BICR, be reliably interpreted?' vote_yes=2 (favorable/yes it can), vote_no=10 (no it cannot). FDA issued CRL Dec 2023. Amgen withdrew sNDA. Verified from CancerNetwork published article.

records.committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
records.indication: Anemia of chronic kidney disease in adult dialysis patients
records.notes: CRDAC voted 13-3 benefits outweigh risks for daprodustat in dialysis patients. A separate question on non-dialysis patients voted 5-11 against (rejected as dedup collision, see reject ledger). FDA approved Feb 2023 as Jesduvroq for dialysis patients only. Verified from GSK press release; corroborated by Medthority, Healio, PharmacyTimes.

records.indication: Previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) in combination with R-CHP
records.notes: ODAC voted 11-2 in favor of clinical benefit of Polivy+R-CHP for untreated DLBCL. First treatment in 20 years to show significant PFS improvement. sBLA approved Apr 19, 2023. Verified from Genentech press release.

records.indication: Mild-to-moderate COVID-19 in adult patients at high risk for progression to severe illness
records.notes: AMDAC voted 16-1 that data support safety and effectiveness of Paxlovid. PDUFA action date May 2023; FDA approved May 25, 2023. Verified from Pfizer press release.

records.indication: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after at least one prior line of therapy (earlier-line expansion)
records.notes: ODAC voted 11-0 favorable risk-benefit for cilta-cel in earlier-line R/R MM (CARTITUDE-4). FDA approved Apr 5, 2024. Previously rejected due to v2 dedup key collision with Abecma (same date/committee/qtype); unblocked by v3 schema adding drug_name to dedup key. Verified from Legend Biotech investor relations press release.

records.committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
records.indication: Anemia of chronic kidney disease in adult non-dialysis patients
records.notes: CRDAC voted 5-11 benefits do NOT outweigh risks for daprodustat in non-dialysis CKD patients. FDA approved for dialysis patients only (Feb 2023). Previously rejected due to v2 dedup key collision with dialysis-population vote (same date/committee/qtype); unblocked by v3 schema adding drug_name to dedup key. Verified from GSK press release; corroborated by Medthority, Healio.
